card.name: Partway through medical and place terms
card.fires_on: Partway through longer words or phrases, such as ventricular, fatality, a place name, or a comma in a list of adverse events, in label text. The next word is not predictable from a natural-disaster topic.

modes.label: Inside split medical words
modes.description: Fires on the middle piece of a long clinical word like ventricular or fatality.
modes.example: HERCEPTIN HYLECTA can cause left vent<<ricular>> cardiac dysfunction, arrhythmias, hypertension

modes.label: List punctuation and linking words
modes.description: Fires on a comma or 'including' inside a list of adverse events.
modes.example: Active tuberculosis,<< including>> reactivation of latent tuberculosis.

modes.label: Place name piece
modes.description: Fires on a piece of a foreign place name in encyclopedia text.
